label: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 (unsupported)
type: the TLS protocol versions Couchbase Server no longer supports: `tlsv1` and `tlsv1.1` were deprecated in 7.2 and removed in 7.6 and later. The minimum negotiable version is now a cluster security setting.
evidence: Couchbase Server 7.6 and later do not support TLS versions 1 and 1.1\.
Support for these earlier versions was deprecated in Couchbase Server 7.2\.
The values `tlsv1` and `tlsv1.1` were deprecated in Couchbase Server 7.2, and are no longer supported by Couchbase Server 7.6 and later versions.
note: A deprecate-then-remove pair with both versions named on both pages - the cleanest `deprecatedIn` + `doesNotSupport` evidence in the round. Filed as one concept rather than two because the documentation never treats the versions separately: every statement names both.
